summary: Removes an array element by index using swap-with-last in O(1). Reads the index from *a2, decrements the element count at this[0], copies the last slot (at array base + 4*newcount) into the removed slot, writes the removed index into the first dword of the object stored at the removed slot, resets *a2 to -1, and returns the removed index. No guards. Callers: ConditionalCleanupChain (0040F100), StateDependentUpdateDispatch (0040F130), LazyInitCallback (004E0D00).

operations.description: result = *a2 (index of the element to remove); v3 = *this - 1 (new count)
Store the decremented count v3 back into this[0]
Copy slot[newcount] (array base this[2] + 4*v3) into slot[result] (array base this[2] + 4*result), swapping the last element over the removed slot
Dereference the pointer stored at slot[result] and write the removed index result into its first dword
Reset the caller's index *a2 to -1 to mark the slot as free
Return the removed element index result
Invoked by ConditionalCleanupChain (0040F100), StateDependentUpdateDispatch (0040F130), and LazyInitCallback (004E0D00)
